newsitem.title: CHINA: FIYTA FIRST-HALF NET 48.55 MLN YUAN.
newsitem.headline: FIYTA FIRST-HALF NET 48.55 MLN YUAN.

text.p: Shenzhen Fiyta Holdings Ltd posted net profits of 48.55 million yuan for the first half of 1997, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange said on Monday.
The company's per-share net reached 0.351 yuan, with net assets per share valued at 2.869 yuan at the end of June, the exchange said in a notice issued after the market closed.
The exchange did not give any comparative figures or clarify whether the results were compiled under Chinese or international accounting standards.
The company, a Shenzhen-based watch maker, booked net profits of 26.18 million yuan on sales of 153.08 million yuan for the first half of 1996 under Chinese accounting standards.
Fiyta planned to make a six-for-10 bonus issue this year based on its capital reserves, the exchange said, but gave no further details.
Trading in the company's A shares and B shares would be suspended on Tuesday morning and resume in the afternoon, the exchange said.
